description: This Scala source file defines the ReceiverSchedulingPolicy class used in Apache Spark Streaming to manage receiver scheduling, including global and local scheduling strategies, for evenly distributing receivers across executors.

classes.name: ReceiverSchedulingPolicy
classes.description: A class responsible for scheduling receivers with an emphasis on even distribution, handling both global and local scheduling phases.

methods.name: scheduleReceivers
methods.description: Schedules receivers across executors, respecting preferred locations and aiming for even distribution.

methods.name: rescheduleReceiver
methods.description: Provides candidate locations for a receiver, balancing load and respecting preferred locations.

methods.name: convertReceiverTrackingInfoToExecutorWeights
methods.description: Converts receiver tracking info into executor weights to assist in load balancing.
